distinct_hypotheses_and_findings: Corrected candidate argument storage: retail argument r8 points to candidate+0x60 and r9 to candidate+0x48; the prior reconstruction reversed these fields.
Indexed candidate traversal generates the retail strength-reduced cursor copy and GPR allocation; an explicit pointer cursor coalesced with the original pointer.
A shared candidate slot expression grouped as (extra_count + 4) + candidate_index reproduces retail argument scheduling across both branches.
Initializing extra_count after obtaining raw_cap and candidates allows the raw-count/capped-count copy and register reuse. A distinct limited local reproduces the later minimum-result copy.
Separating loop-constant declarations from assignments retains f30/f31 allocation while loading lower before upper.
Initialization uses explicit x/y/z result locals and a lower-offset local; loading/storing y before assigning target.y - lower yields exact retail FPR lifetimes.

milestones.hypothesis: explicit lower temporary and target.y expression
